title: Little G
description: Gives Some Blocks nd Items a Golden Touch If Yk What I Mean
body:
🍁 Introduction:

**The Little G** is a pack that changes the textures of the Crafting Table, Enchanting Table, the Bow and the Enchanting Book to give them a Golden touch. Hope you enjoy the pack :)
